connector.name: Liminality
connector.registryDescription: Breaks a hard question or decision into grounded sub-questions and returns a checkable route.
connector.summary: Hosted at liminality.physea.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.physea, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your Liminality API key (get one free at https://physea.ai/signup — first 50 solves on any key are free).
